meals.recipe_name: Protein Banana Oatmeal with Scrambled Eggs
recipe_steps: In a small saucepan, combine 1 cup rolled oats and 1.5 cups whole milk. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring often, about 5 minutes until thick.
Remove from heat and let cool 1 minute, then stir in 1 scoop vanilla whey protein until smooth (adding off-heat prevents clumping).
Slice 1 banana on top and drizzle with 1 tbsp honey.
Crack 3 eggs into a bowl and whisk with a pinch of salt.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Add eggs and stir gently with a spatula for 2-3 minutes until softly set. Serve alongside the oatmeal.
Spoon half of 1 cup Greek yogurt into a glass or bowl.
Layer with half of 0.75 cup mixed berries and half of 0.33 cup granola.
Repeat the layers with remaining yogurt, berries, and granola.
Drizzle 1 tbsp honey over the top and serve immediately.
Pat 8 oz chicken breast dry and rub with 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder, 0.5 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp olive oil.
Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high for 2 minutes. Cook chicken 5-6 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Warm 1.5 cups cooked rice and 0.75 cup black beans (drained) in the microwave or a small pot for 2 minutes.
Build the bowl: rice base, then beans, 0.5 cup corn, sliced chicken, 0.25 cup cheddar, and 0.5 sliced avocado.
Squeeze 0.5 lime over the top and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Sunday night to thaw fully for Monday lunch (~18 hrs).

Rinse 2 cups white rice until water runs clear. Combine with 3 cups water and 1 tsp salt in a pot; bring to boil, cover, reduce to low, cook 18 min, rest 10 min covered. Refrigerate in a sealed container for use across early-week meals.

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese with Pineapple and Almonds
recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 0.75 cup pineapple chunks and 0.25 cup almonds.
Stir gently and serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Garlic Butter and Roasted Potatoes
recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Halve 10 oz baby potatoes, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, 0.5 tsp salt, and pepper. Roast 25 minutes on a sheet pan.
Add 6 oz asparagus (tossed in 0.5 tbsp oil) to the pan for the last 10 minutes.
Pat 8 oz salmon dry and season with 0.5 tsp salt and pepper.
Heat 0.5 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear salmon skin-side down 4 minutes, flip, cook 3 minutes to internal 130°F.
Reduce heat to low; add 2 tbsp butter and 3 minced garlic cloves. Spoon foaming garlic butter over salmon for 1 minute.
Squeeze 0.5 lemon over everything and plate with potatoes and asparagus.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Sunday night for Monday dinner (~24 hrs). If forgotten, cold-water thaw sealed Monday afternoon ~30 min.

meals.recipe_name: Turkey Sausage and Egg Breakfast Tacos
recipe_steps: Make tortillas: mix 1.25 cups flour, 0.5 tsp baking powder, 0.5 tsp salt. Add 1 tbsp olive oil and 0.5 cup warm water; knead 5 min into a smooth dough. Rest 15 min.
Divide dough into 4 balls, roll each thin, and cook in a dry skillet over medium-high 45 seconds per side until puffed. Keep warm.
Season 5 oz ground turkey with 0.5 tsp cumin, 0.5 tsp paprika, 0.25 tsp salt. Brown in skillet over medium-high 6 minutes, breaking apart.
Whisk 3 eggs and scramble in the same pan 2-3 minutes until set.
Fill tortillas with turkey, eggs, 0.25 cup cheddar, and 0.25 cup salsa. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 5 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Monday morning for Tuesday breakfast (~24 hrs).

recipe_steps: Add 1.5 cups whole milk, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 1 banana, 2 tbsp peanut butter, and 0.25 cup rolled oats to a blender.
Blend on high 45 seconds until smooth.
Pour into a glass and drink immediately.
Make sauce: whisk 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 tsp cornstarch, and 2 tbsp water.
Steam 6 oz broccoli 4 minutes until bright green.
Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add 8 oz shrimp; cook 2 minutes per side until pink.
Pour sauce into pan; simmer 1-2 minutes until it thickens and coats the shrimp.
Serve over 1.5 cups warmed rice with broccoli, sprinkled with 1 tsp sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Cold-water thaw 8 oz sealed shrimp Tuesday morning ~20 min, changing water once. Or move to fridge Monday night.

recipe_steps: Drain 1 can tuna and flake into a bowl.
Mix in 1 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, finely diced celery stalk, and a squeeze of lemon.
Season with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Serve with 12 whole grain crackers.

meals.recipe_name: Beef Stir-Fry with Peppers over Rice
recipe_steps: Slice 8 oz beef sirloin thin against the grain; toss with 1 tsp cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Slice 1 bell pepper and 0.5 onion. Mince 2 garlic cloves.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat. Sear beef 2 minutes until browned; remove.
Add 0.5 tbsp oil, then peppers and onion; stir-fry 3 minutes. Add garlic 30 seconds.
Return beef, add 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp oyster sauce; toss 1 minute.
Serve over 1.5 cups warmed rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz beef sirloin from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday dinner (~20 hrs).

meals.recipe_name: Spinach Feta Egg White Omelette with Toast
recipe_steps: Make quick flatbread toast: mix 1 cup flour, 0.5 tsp yeast, 0.5 tsp salt, 1 tbsp olive oil, and 0.4 cup warm water. Knead 5 min, cover, rest per prep task.
Roll dough thin, cook in dry skillet over medium 2 min per side. Set aside.
Whisk 2 whole eggs with 4 egg whites and 0.25 tsp salt.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium. Add 1.5 cups spinach; wilt 1 minute.
Pour in eggs; let set 2 minutes. Sprinkle 0.25 cup feta on one half, fold over, cook 1 minute. Serve with flatbread.

prep_tasks.instructions: Tuesday night mix 1 cup flour, 0.5 tsp yeast, 0.5 tsp salt, 1 tbsp olive oil, 0.4 cup warm water. Knead 5 min, place in oiled covered bowl, cold ferment in fridge overnight. Pull to room temp Wednesday morning before cooking.

recipe_steps: Blend 1 cup cottage cheese, 1 scoop chocolate whey, and 0.25 cup milk until completely smooth, about 30 seconds.
Spoon into a bowl.
Slice 1 banana over the top and add 0.25 cup almonds. Serve immediately.
Make wraps: mix 1.25 cups flour, 0.5 tsp baking powder, 0.5 tsp salt, 1 tbsp olive oil, 0.5 cup warm water. Knead 5 min, rest 15 min, divide into 2, roll thin, cook in dry skillet 1 min per side.
Season 7 oz chicken with 0.25 tsp salt. Sear in oiled skillet over medium-high 5-6 min per side to 165°F. Rest, slice.
Toss 2 cups chopped romaine with 3 tbsp Caesar dressing and 0.25 cup parmesan.
Fill wraps with salad and chicken; roll tightly and slice in half.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday lunch (~16 hrs).

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt with Honey, Walnuts and Granola
recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 0.25 cup walnuts and 0.33 cup granola.
Drizzle 1 tbsp honey over the top and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Pork Chops with Apple Glaze and Mashed Potatoes
recipe_steps: Peel and cube 12 oz potatoes; boil in salted water 15 min until tender. Drain, mash with 2 tbsp butter, 0.25 cup milk, and 0.5 tsp salt.
Steam 6 oz green beans 4 minutes.
Season 10 oz pork chops with 0.5 tsp salt. Sear in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high 4 min per side to 145°F. Remove and rest.
In the same pan, add 1 diced apple, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp vinegar, and 1 tbsp butter. Simmer 3 minutes into a glaze.
Spoon apple glaze over pork; serve with mash and green beans.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 10 oz pork chops from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday dinner (~20 hrs).

meals.recipe_name: Protein Pancakes with Greek Yogurt and Berries
recipe_steps: Whisk 0.75 cup flour, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 1 tsp baking powder, and a pinch of salt.
Add 2 eggs and 0.75 cup milk; whisk into a smooth batter.
Melt a little butter in a nonstick skillet over medium. Ladle batter to form pancakes; cook 2 min until bubbles form, flip, cook 1-2 min.
Stack pancakes; top with 0.5 cup Greek yogurt, 0.5 cup berries, and 2 tbsp maple syrup.
Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 0.75 cup berries, and 1 tbsp peanut butter to a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until smooth.
Serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Bison Burger with Sweet Potato Wedges
recipe_steps: Bake buns (see prep task) then bring to room temp; slice in half.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Cut 10 oz sweet potato into wedges, toss with 1 tbsp oil and 0.5 tsp salt, roast 25 min flipping once.
Form 8 oz bison into a patty; season with 0.5 tsp salt and pepper.
Heat 0.5 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high; cook patty 4 min per side to 160°F, adding cheddar in the last minute to melt.
Assemble burger with lettuce and tomato on the bun; serve with wedges.

prep_tasks.instructions: Monday, mix 1.25 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 0.5 tsp salt, 1 egg, 2 tbsp warm milk, 1 tbsp softened butter. Knead 8 min, proof 1 hr, shape 2 buns, proof 30 min, bake 375°F 15 min. Cool fully and freeze in a sealed bag.
Wednesday night move frozen buns to counter and 8 oz ground bison from freezer to fridge for Thursday lunch (~16 hrs).

meals.recipe_name: Hummus Veggie Plate with Boiled Eggs
recipe_steps: Boil 2 eggs: place in boiling water 9 minutes, transfer to ice water, peel, halve.
Slice 1 cup carrots and 0.5 bell pepper into sticks.
Arrange 0.5 cup hummus in a bowl with veggies, 8 crackers, and eggs. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Baked Cod with Lemon Rice and Zucchini
recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Place 9 oz cod in a baking dish; top with 2 tbsp butter, 2 minced garlic cloves, juice of 0.5 lemon, and 0.5 tsp salt. Bake 15 minutes to 140°F.
Slice 1 zucchini; sauté in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high 5 minutes until golden.
Warm 1.5 cups rice and stir in juice of 0.5 lemon and chopped parsley.
Plate cod over lemon rice with zucchini alongside; spoon pan juices over top.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 9 oz cod fillet from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday dinner (~22 hrs).
Rinse 1.5 cups white rice, combine with 2.25 cups water and 0.75 tsp salt; boil, cover, simmer low 18 min, rest 10 min. Refrigerate for Thursday and Friday meals.

meals.recipe_name: Bacon, Egg and Cheese Breakfast Sandwich
recipe_steps: Toast the pre-made English-muffin-style roll (see prep task); slice and toast cut sides in a dry skillet.
Cook 3 slices turkey bacon in a skillet over medium 3 min per side until crisp; set aside.
Whisk 3 eggs; cook in 1 tbsp butter in a ring or free-form 3 minutes, folding to fit the roll.
Layer egg, cheddar slice, and bacon on the roll; press the top to melt cheese. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Monday, mix 1.25 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.5 cup warm water, 1 tbsp butter. Knead 8 min, proof 1 hr, shape 2 rolls, proof 30 min, bake 375°F 14 min. Cool and freeze.
Thursday night move 1 frozen breakfast roll to the counter for Friday breakfast.

recipe_steps: Cook the pre-fermented flatbread (see prep task) in a dry skillet over medium 2 min per side.
Spread 1 cup cottage cheese over the warm flatbread.
Top with 0.5 sliced tomato, a drizzle of 1 tbsp olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Thursday night mix 1 cup flour, 0.5 tsp yeast, 0.5 tsp salt, 1 tbsp olive oil, 0.4 cup warm water. Knead 5 min, cold ferment in covered oiled bowl overnight; pull to room temp Friday morning.

recipe_steps: Slice the pre-baked sandwich bread (see prep task) into 3 slices; toast lightly.
Spread 1 tbsp mayo and mash 0.5 avocado onto slices.
Layer 6 oz turkey, cheddar, lettuce, and tomato; stack as a double-decker club.
Slice diagonally and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Monday, mix 1.5 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.6 cup warm water, 1 tbsp oil. Knead 8 min, proof 1 hr, shape a small loaf, proof 40 min, bake 375°F 25 min. Cool fully and freeze.
Thursday night move the frozen loaf to the fridge/counter to thaw for Friday lunch.

recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 0.25 cup almonds, 2 tbsp walnuts, and 0.25 cup granola.
Drizzle with 1 tbsp honey and serve.
Cube 9 oz chicken; marinate per prep task. Sear in 1 tbsp butter over medium-high 5 min until browned; remove.
In the same pan, melt 1 tbsp butter; sauté 0.5 diced onion 4 min. Add 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp ginger, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp cumin; cook 1 min.
Add 1 cup crushed tomatoes and 0.5 tsp salt; simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in 0.25 cup heavy cream and return chicken; simmer 5 min to 165°F.
Serve over 1.5 cups warmed rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Thursday night move 9 oz chicken from freezer to fridge. Once thawed, cube and marinate in 0.25 cup Greek yogurt, 1 tsp garam masala, 0.5 tsp salt, 1 minced garlic clove; cover and refrigerate 12-18 hrs for Friday dinner.

meals.recipe_name: Steak and Eggs with Hash Browns
recipe_steps: Grate 8 oz potatoes, squeeze out moisture, season with 0.25 tsp salt. Fry in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high, pressing flat, 5 min per side until crispy.
Season 6 oz sirloin with 0.5 tsp salt and pepper. Sear in 1 tbsp oil over high heat 3 min per side to 130°F; rest 5 min, slice.
Fry 3 eggs in 1 tbsp butter to desired doneness, 3 minutes for runny yolks.
Plate steak, eggs, and hash browns together.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 6 oz beef sirloin from freezer to fridge Friday morning for Saturday breakfast (~24 hrs).

recipe_steps: Blend 1 cup frozen mango, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 0.5 cup Greek yogurt, and 0.5 cup milk until thick and smooth.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with 0.33 cup granola and serve immediately with a spoon.
Make tortillas: mix 1.25 cups flour, 0.5 tsp baking powder, 0.5 tsp salt, 1 tbsp oil, 0.5 cup warm water. Knead 5 min, rest 15 min, divide into 4, roll, cook in dry skillet 45 sec per side.
Make slaw: toss 1.5 cups shredded cabbage with 0.25 cup Greek yogurt, juice of 0.5 lime, and a pinch of salt.
Toss 8 oz shrimp with 1 tsp chili powder, 0.5 tsp cumin, 0.25 tsp salt. Sear in a skillet over medium-high 2 min per side.
Fill tortillas with shrimp, slaw, and sliced avocado; squeeze remaining lime over top.

prep_tasks.instructions: Cold-water thaw 8 oz sealed shrimp Saturday morning ~20 min, changing water once. Or move to fridge Friday night.

recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a muffin tin (4 cups).
Whisk 4 eggs with 0.5 tsp salt. Stir in 3 oz diced ham, 0.33 cup cheddar, 0.5 diced bell pepper, and 0.5 cup chopped spinach.
Divide among 4 muffin cups.
Bake 18-20 minutes until set and puffed. Serve warm.

meals.recipe_name: Ribeye with Chimichurri and Roasted Vegetables
recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Halve 8 oz baby potatoes and slice 1 bell pepper; toss with 1 tbsp oil and 0.5 tsp salt. Roast 25 min.
Make chimichurri: mix 0.5 cup minced parsley, 3 minced garlic cloves, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 3 tbsp olive oil, 0.5 tsp red pepper flakes, 0.5 tsp salt.
Season 10 oz ribeye with 0.5 tsp salt and pepper. Sear in 1 tbsp oil over high heat 4 min per side to 130°F.
Rest steak 8 minutes, slice against the grain.
Plate steak with roasted vegetables; spoon chimichurri over the steak.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 10 oz ribeye from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday dinner (~20 hrs).

meals.recipe_name: Smoked Salmon Scrambled Eggs with Bagel
recipe_steps: Split and toast the pre-made bagel (see prep task); spread with 2 tbsp cream cheese.
Whisk 3 eggs with a pinch of salt.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low; add eggs and stir gently 3 minutes until softly set.
Fold in 3 oz smoked salmon torn into pieces and 1 tbsp chives at the end.
Serve scramble alongside the bagel.

prep_tasks.instructions: Monday, mix 1.5 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.55 cup warm water. Knead 10 min, proof 1 hr, shape 2 bagels, boil each 45 sec per side, bake 425°F 18 min. Cool and freeze.
Saturday night move 1 frozen bagel to the counter for Sunday breakfast.

recipe_steps: Retrieve the jar from the fridge (see prep task).
Stir well; top with 0.5 diced apple and 2 tbsp walnuts.
Serve cold.

prep_tasks.instructions: Saturday night combine 0.75 cup rolled oats, 1 cup whole milk, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 0.5 tsp cinnamon in a jar; stir, cover, refrigerate overnight for Sunday.

recipe_steps: Bring the pre-made sub roll (see prep task) to room temp; slice open.
Mix 8 oz ground turkey with 1 egg, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp italian seasoning, 0.5 tsp salt. Form 6 meatballs.
Brown meatballs in 1 tbsp oil over medium 6 min, turning. Add 1 cup crushed tomatoes and simmer 6 min to 165°F.
Load meatballs and sauce into the roll; top with 0.5 cup mozzarella.
Broil 2-3 minutes until cheese melts. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Monday, mix 1.5 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.6 cup warm water, 1 tbsp oil. Knead 8 min, proof 1 hr, shape 2 sub rolls, proof 40 min, bake 375°F 18 min. Cool and freeze.
Saturday night move 1 frozen sub roll to the counter and 8 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge for Sunday lunch.

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese Chocolate Peanut Butter Bowl
recipe_steps: Blend 1 cup cottage cheese with 1 tsp cocoa powder and 1 tbsp honey until smooth.
Spoon into a bowl; swirl in 1 tbsp peanut butter.
Top with 1 sliced banana and serve.
Boil 5 oz linguine in salted water per package, about 9 min. Reserve 0.5 cup pasta water, drain.
Heat 1 tbsp oil and 1 tbsp butter over medium-high; sear 8 oz shrimp 2 min per side, remove.
Lower heat; add 2 tbsp butter, 4 minced garlic cloves, and 0.5 tsp red pepper flakes; cook 1 min.
Add pasta, splash of pasta water, juice of 0.5 lemon, and 0.33 cup parmesan; toss to a glossy sauce.
Return shrimp, add 2 tbsp parsley, toss and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz shrimp from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday dinner (~20 hrs), or cold-water thaw sealed Sunday afternoon ~20 min.
